clips.send: Two equations that must be true at the same time form a system of equations. Its solution is the ordered pair that makes both true; on the graph it is the intersection point of the two lines.
clips.text: Two equations that must be true at the same time form a system of equations. Its solution is the ordered pair that makes both true; on the graph it is the intersection point of the two lines.

clips.send: Elimination: stack the two clues as bars. Clue 2 has everything clue 1 has plus one more y , and its total is 10 minus 7 equals 3 bigger. Subtracting the equations cancels x and leaves y equals 3 .
clips.text: Elimination: stack the two clues as bars. Clue 2 has everything clue 1 has plus one more y, and its total is 10 - 7 = 3 bigger. Subtracting the equations cancels x and leaves y = 3.

clips.send: Worked example: adult tickets cost 5 dollars, child tickets 3 dollars, and 10 tickets cost 38 dollars. Multiply the first equation by 3 and subtract: y cancels, leaving 2x equals 8 , so x equals 4 adults and y equals 6 children. Always check in both equations!
clips.text: Worked example: adult tickets cost 5 dollars, child tickets 3 dollars, and 10 tickets cost 38 dollars. Multiply the first equation by 3 and subtract: y cancels, leaving 2x = 8, so x = 4 adults and y = 6 children. Always check in both equations!

clips.send: A puzzle: you buy 7 snacks and spend exactly 10 dollars. Cookies cost 1 dollar each and juice boxes cost 2 dollars each. Call the number of cookies x and juice boxes y . A first guess, 3 cookies and 4 juice boxes, costs 11 dollars, too much!
clips.text: A puzzle: you buy 7 snacks and spend exactly 10 dollars. Cookies cost 1 dollar each and juice boxes cost 2 dollars each. Call the number of cookies x and juice boxes y. A first guess, 3 cookies and 4 juice boxes, costs 11 dollars, too much!

clips.send: Graphs can be hard to read exactly, so we also solve with algebra. Substitution: clue 1 says x equals 7 minus y . Put that in place of x in clue 2: (7 minus y) plus 2y equals 10 , so y equals 3 , and then x equals 4 .
clips.text: Graphs can be hard to read exactly, so we also solve with algebra. Substitution: clue 1 says x = 7 - y. Put that in place of x in clue 2: (7 - y) + 2y = 10, so y = 3, and then x = 4.

clips.send: Which guess fits both clues? Only the point on both lines: where they cross, (4, 3) . Check: 4 plus 3 equals 7 and 4 plus 2 times 3 equals 10 . So you bought 4 cookies and 3 juice boxes.
clips.text: Which guess fits both clues? Only the point on both lines: where they cross, (4, 3). Check: 4 + 3 = 7 ✓ and 4 + 2 times 3 = 10 ✓. So you bought 4 cookies and 3 juice boxes.

clips.send: Now use only the second clue, the cost: 1 dollar per cookie and 2 dollars per juice box gives x plus 2y equals 10 . Its guesses (0, 5), (2, 4), (4, 3)… also line up, on a different line.

clips.send: Use only the first clue, 7 items: x plus y equals 7 . Try every guess: 0 cookies and 7 juice boxes, 1 and 6, 2 and 5… Plot each guess as a point (x, y) . They all land on one straight line!

clips.send: Must two lines always meet exactly once? No! Parallel lines never meet: no solution. Two equations for the same line share every point: infinitely many solutions. Otherwise they cross exactly once.

clips.send: 例题：成人票每张 5 元，儿童票每张 3 元，买 10 张票共花 38 元。把第一个方程乘 3 再相减， y 被消去： 2x 等于 8 ，所以 x 等于 4 （成人）， y 等于 6 （儿童）。最后一定要代入两个方程检验！
clips.text: 例题：成人票每张 5 元，儿童票每张 3 元，买 10 张票共花 38 元。把第一个方程乘 3 再相减，y 被消去：2x = 8，所以 x = 4（成人），y = 6（儿童）。最后一定要代入两个方程检验！

clips.send: 加减消元法：把两个条件画成线段图上下对齐。第二个条件比第一个多出一个 y ，总数也多了 10 减 7 等于 3 。两个方程相减， x 被消去，剩下 y 等于 3 。
clips.text: 加减消元法：把两个条件画成线段图上下对齐。第二个条件比第一个多出一个 y，总数也多了 10 - 7 = 3。两个方程相减，x 被消去，剩下 y = 3。

clips.send: 必须同时成立的两个方程合在一起，叫作方程组。方程组的解是使两个方程都成立的有序数对；在图像上，它就是两条直线的交点。
clips.text: 必须同时成立的两个方程合在一起，叫作方程组。方程组的解是使两个方程都成立的有序数对；在图像上，它就是两条直线的交点。

clips.send: 先只用第一个条件——一共 7 件： x 加 y 等于 7 。把所有可能都试一遍：0 块饼干和 7 盒果汁，1 和 6,2 和 5……把每组猜测画成点 (x, y) 。它们全都落在同一条直线上！
clips.text: 先只用第一个条件——一共 7 件：x + y = 7。把所有可能都试一遍：0 块饼干和 7 盒果汁，1 和 6,2 和 5……把每组猜测画成点 (x, y)。它们全都落在同一条直线上！

clips.send: 再只用第二个条件——总价：饼干 1 元一块、果汁 2 元一盒，得到 x 加 2y 等于 10 。满足它的（0, 5）、（2, 4）、（4, 3)……同样排成一条直线，但是另一条。
clips.text: 再只用第二个条件——总价：饼干 1 元一块、果汁 2 元一盒，得到 x + 2y = 10。满足它的（0, 5）、（2, 4）、（4, 3)……同样排成一条直线，但是另一条。

clips.send: 容易混淆：方程组的解必须同时满足两个方程。只在一条直线上的点（只满足一个方程）不是解。另外，解要写成有序数对（x, y），顺序不能颠倒。
clips.text: 容易混淆：方程组的解必须同时满足两个方程。只在一条直线上的点（只满足一个方程）不是解。另外，解要写成有序数对（x, y），顺序不能颠倒。

clips.send: 看图不一定读得准，所以还要会用代数方法。代入消元法：由第一个方程得 x 等于 7 减 y ，把它代入第二个方程替换 x : (7 减 y) 加 2y 等于 10 ，解得 y 等于 3 ，进而 x 等于 4 。
clips.text: 看图不一定读得准，所以还要会用代数方法。代入消元法：由第一个方程得 x = 7 - y，把它代入第二个方程替换 x:(7 - y) + 2y = 10，解得 y = 3，进而 x = 4。

clips.send: 哪一组同时满足两个条件？只有同时在两条直线上的点——它们的交点 (4, 3) 。检验： 4 加 3 等于 7 , 4 加 2 乘 3 等于 10 。所以你买了 4 块饼干和 3 盒果汁。
clips.text: 哪一组同时满足两个条件？只有同时在两条直线上的点——它们的交点 (4, 3)。检验：4 + 3 = 7 ✓,4 + 2 times 3 = 10 ✓。所以你买了 4 块饼干和 3 盒果汁。

clips.send: 两条直线一定恰好相交一次吗？不一定！平行的直线永不相交：无解。如果两个方程表示同一条直线（重合），所有点都是公共点：有无数个解。其余情况都恰好相交于一点。

clips.send: 一道谜题：你买了 7 件零食，正好花了 10 元。饼干每块 1 元，果汁每盒 2 元。设饼干有 x 块，果汁有 y 盒。先猜一下：3 块饼干和 4 盒果汁要 11 元——多了！
